latest_release.name: v3.0.0
latest_release.body:
**【重要公告 / Important Announcement】**

据 SukiSU Ultra 内部讨论与慎重决定，SukiSU Ultra 项目将自本日起正式停止一切功能更新与日常维护。
Following internal discussions and careful consideration, the SukiSU Ultra team has decided that the project will officially cease all feature updates and routine maintenance starting today.

自项目发布以来，SukiSU Ultra 陪伴大家走过了一段难忘的时光。在此，我们由衷感谢每一位用户在过去日子里的支持、信任与陪伴，也感谢所有为项目贡献过代码、提交过 Issue 以及在社区中积极反馈的开发者与朋友们。正是因为有你们的热爱，这个项目才能一路走到今天。天下没有不散的筵席，感谢大家的理解，愿我们江湖再见。
Since its initial release, SukiSU Ultra has shared an unforgettable journey with all of you. We would like to express our deepest gratitude to every single user for your unwavering support, trust, and companionship over the past months, as well as to all the developers and community members who contributed code, reported issues, and provided valuable feedback. It was your passion that carried this project to where it is today. All good things must come to an end—thank you for your understanding, and we wish you all the best.

.
.
.
.
.

其实我们并没有停更，也没有跑路！只是项目从今天起正式更名为 **SukiSU Nova** 啦！原来的团队（虽然就两人了）和开发工作都会在新的名字下继续推进。
We aren't actually discontinuing development or going anywhere! The project is simply rebranding to **SukiSU Nova** starting today, and the same team (even though it's down to just two of us) will continue all ongoing development under this new name.

---

### ❓ 为什么之前的 Release 都不见了？ / Why are all previous Releases gone?

因为项目主作者 **ShirkNeko** 的 GitHub 账号不幸遭到了封禁，导致原仓库下的历史 Release 全部被隐藏了。
Due to the GitHub account suspension of our lead developer, **ShirkNeko**, all previous Releases under the original repository have been hidden.

### 📺 详细原因视频讲解 / Full Story Video

至于为什么要突然改名、新名字的含义的具体细节，我们已经制作了一期视频为大家详细讲解，欢迎观看：
For the full story behind the sudden rebrand, the meaning of the new name, and more details, check out our dedicated explanation video:

👉 【SukiSU Ultra 停更了…但不是你想的那樣 - 嗶哩嗶哩】 [https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1Aysu6hEWK?p=1&unique_k=2333](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1Aysu6hEWK?p=1&unique_k=2333)
